summary: Suggest a hand-shaped object through soft mass transitions and a few intentional surface irregularities.
objective: A close view reveals deliberate sculpting cues rather than generic smooth blobs; adjacent clay-colored parts remain separable.
intent_signals: Show soft sculpted masses and deliberate imperfections
example_prompts: Create a clay-like friendly creature with pressed-in features and distinct articulated limbs.

principles: Suggest a hand-shaped object through soft mass transitions and a few intentional surface irregularities.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Use rounded joins, slightly uneven rims and broad sculpted indentations; decide which seams are construction features.
Choose subdued highlights and an earthy or invented palette under a large soft key; retain enough value contrast between touching forms.
Use a close three-quarter inspection view; slow squash or joint motion may fit fictional figures, while technical assemblies keep their model constraints.
observable_checks: A close view reveals deliberate sculpting cues rather than generic smooth blobs; adjacent clay-colored parts remain separable.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

creative_affordances: Combine with toy-miniature proportions or stop-motion-inspired timing; visual clay does not imply a deformable physical model.
